svg.title: Derivation map
svg.desc: Ten blocks derive every table from the metric and the orientation of the volume element, in the order of the code: bases, metric, parts, transitional products, interior products, geometric products, norms, properties, projections and motion operators. Each box holds a symbol, each operator of a formula enters its box by a line, and each anti table stands under its base. Each line carries its formula and the function that builds the table. Faded lines are routes that the code does not take, and faded boxes are operators with no table.
svg.text: route the code does not take
